capabilities.label: Clinical service delivery
capabilities.notes: Medical care is delivered through NC Medicaid Managed Care health plans and providers, not by DHHS staff

capabilities.label: Behavioral health service delivery

capabilities.notes: Division of Public Health runs statewide surveillance, including NC DETECT behavioral health syndromic surveillance (DHHS Strategic Plan 2023-25, strategy G3.5.2, PDF p.15)

capabilities.notes: DHHS invests in enterprise data collection, integration and storage for staff and partners (DHHS Strategic Plan 2023-25, strategy G5.1.3, PDF p.19)

capabilities.notes: Non-emergency medical transportation is provided by Medicaid health plans through transportation brokers, and by county DSS for Medicaid Direct
